subject: [AMBER] Calculating RMSD between apoprotein and protein-ligand complex

messages.author: Alexander Hung Lee
messages.body:
Hello,
I ran a 1us md of the apoprotein and want to compare 2 specific residues with that of the ligand-bound version of it. I deleted the ligand from the reference. Because they're sourced from 2 different crystal structures, they don't have the same # of residues. I was following this tutorial for RMSD use with different topologies
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/analysis/tutorial1/index.php
and this is what I have so far... I don't know if I'm doing this correctly?
parm apo.pdb
trajin apo.nc
parm reference.pdb
reference reference.pdb parm reference.pdb [reference]
rms ref [reference] :2-136.CA :1-135.CA
rms ref [reference] :118 :117 out GLN.txt nofit
rms ref [reference] :3 :2 out TYR.txt nofit
run
